resources.string: A CANable or other slcan adapter on the car\'s CAN bus

A USB CAN adapter on slcan firmware, such as a CANable, wired to the car\'s CAN-H, CAN-L and ground. Dashwheel only listens and never sends on the car\'s bus. Pick it below, then add readings From the CAN bus in My readings.
500k for most cars since 2008. If nothing comes, try 125k or 250k.
It did not answer slcan commands. A CANable needs its slcan firmware: with candleLight it is not a serial port.
Its firmware can\'t listen without sending, so Dashwheel leaves it closed. Update its slcan firmware.
Nothing heard: switch the ignition on, check the wiring, or try another bus speed.
Each line is an id and its last bytes. Press a pedal or open a door: the line that changes carries it.
